results.title: DRI seizes 7.85 kg of hashish smuggled from U.S. to Mumbai in mirror frame; one arrested
results.content: Following the seizure, DRI officials traced the consignee of the parcel and arrested the person on November 2 under the provisions of the NDPS Act, 1985. The agency has not disclosed the identity of the arrested person

results.title: Sharad Pawar admitted to Mumbai hospital after Pune discharge
results.content: Earlier in the day, the 85-year-old Sharad Pawar was discharged from Ruby Hall Clinic in Pune, where he was admitted on November 2, following complaints of cough and pleuritic (chest) pain

results.title: East Delhi Police to hold weekly grievance meetings every Friday at 4 p.m. after ACP Manasvi Vashishta’s suspension over parking row
results.content: The move follows the Shahdara parking dispute that escalated into a lawyers-police face-off and a protest by over 100 police personnel outside Delhi Police headquarters, prompting the suspension of the ACP

results.title: Mumbai’s Byculla Zoo closer to getting four Asiatic lions from Gujarat
results.content: Under the proposed exchange, the Mumbai zoo will transfer three pairs of tufted capuchin monkeys to Sakkarbaug. Both zoos have already agreed to the exchange, the BMC said

results.title: U.S. midterm results may matter less for India-U.S. ties than for India’s room to manoeuvre in geopolitics
results.content: With U.S. President Donald Trump’s Republicans facing a major loss, the results could affect India’s position on the Iran war, Russian oil, the trade deal, immigration and China policy

results.title: U.S. slaps sanctions on Indian, Turkish firms and people for aiding Iran
results.content: The sanctions are part of the Trump administration’s “Operation Economic Outcast,” which aims to cut off Iran’s ability to sell oil to fund the war with the U.S. and Israel

results.title: Delhi Police arrest man with 312 kg of illegal firecrackers in Shahdara
results.content: The 26-year-old was allegedly storing and selling firecrackers from his Balbir Nagar residence; police have registered a case and are verifying his criminal antecedents

results.title: Mahadev app co-promoter Ravi Uppal arrested in UAE, India moves for his extradition
results.content: Authorities in Dubai arrested a 46-year-old Ravi Uppal based on an Interpol Red Notice issued by Indian probe agencies, officials told PTI

results.title: Falling fertility rate makes two-child penalties outdated in India, says Supreme Court
results.content: ‘The foundation of such laws, that is, the fear of overpopulation, has crumbled due to demographic changes in the past few decades’, says Bench

results.title: Every rooftop in Delhi will become source of solar energy: CM
results.content: The CM said that the Delhi government is encouraging people to install rooftop solar systems

results.title: Indian shooters miss medal targets
results.content: The 10m air rifle mixed team pair of Sonam Uttam Maskar and Himanshu Dhillon failed to qualify for the four-team final, finishing seventh with an aggregate of 632.4. Sonam shot 316.6, while Himanshu returned 315.8

results.title: Raipur court grants CBI eight days custody of Sourabh Chandrakar; to be interrogated in Delhi
results.content: The development follows the recent extradition of Chandrakar from Oman to Delhi, after which he was brought to Raipur on a private flight on November 3 evening.

results.title: Mumbai woman arrested for hacking demat account, selling shares worth ₹4.58 crore
results.content: During the investigation, police found that the one-time passwords (OTPs) required to access the Demat account had been received at the complainant’s registered email address

results.title: Eleven tribals arrested for seeking rehabilitation for a proposed land port project in West Bengal
results.content: Construction at the Land Ports Authority of India (LPAI) site in Gotabari, Torsa Tea Garden, had been going on for nearly five months and during the period, the locals maintained a peaceful, indefinite dharna beside the project site for over 100 days

results.title: Spend more time in India: Rijiju takes jibe at Rahul, list conditions for Congress to ‘win more MPs’
results.content: Kiren Rijiju has been taking on Rahul Gandhi and other Congress leaders for demanding an open debate with the Prime Minister
